challenge: Anthropic x Adaptyv 2026 Challenge 5 / Track 3 (pMHC): de-novo zero-shot binder selective for KRAS G12D VVVGADGVGK on HLA-A*11:01 + b2m
selection_principle: North star: rank by the WEAKEST discrimination margin min(spec_scram, promisc_margin, bp-bh_e), not composite sel; improve the weakest objective; test all three targets (G12D/WT/empty); one convincing pose is not discrimination; submit diverse designs with honest reasoning; computational confidence is a hypothesis, the experiment is the verdict. What shows it recognizes the difference, not merely what the targets share?

features.desc: User selects the final 20 by the WEAKEST-objective (minimax) lens balanced with diversity; then gated upload
features.evidence: combined_submission.csv portal-format-validated (20/20 passed). Minimax lens (scripts/weakest_objective.py -> runs/campaign/weakest_objective.tsv): proposed 20 are ALL positive on the weakest margin; the 7 locked designs with a NEGATIVE weakest margin (bind empty groove or other peptides >= G12D) are EXACTLY the DROP set (a CONSISTENCY CHECK on the same co-fold scores that chose the swap, NOT independent evidence; it shows why the dropped designs are weak but does not predict lab behavior; wet-lab is the verdict). Proposed 20's own weakest links are retained incumbents (protein_0103 #155, b2_gpu5_37 #164) = a further minimax refinement option.
features.done_criteria: final 20 chosen by weakest discrimination margin + diversity + honest reasoning (north star), not composite sel; upload remains user-gated
